prompt:
SCENE CONTEXT & STYLE
Kneeling at the dais, the narrator reaches desperately toward the cracked harp as his hands begin to glow and dissolve into particles of light; the harpist looks down at him.
Style: stylized 3D animated feature film look (soft subsurface skin, expressive faces, detailed curly hair, cloth simulation), vertical 9:16. Lighting: timeless soft daylight, tangerine key light, turquoise fill, bright golden mist. World physics: slightly exaggerated cartoon physics, readable comedic timing.
- The narrator wears a pale blue hospital gown and is barefoot in every Heaven shot; in the hospital he wears a pale blue hospital gown in bed.
- The harp is one ornate golden floor harp; once broken it stays broken (3 loose strings, snapped column, split base).
- Mouths may move on dialogue, but there is no spoken audio; the voice-over is added in post.

ACTIVE REFERENCES
@narrator = Narrator (character): the new arrival, an atheist who just died in surgery. Personality: flustered, clumsy, guilty, then determined
@harpist = Harpist angel (character): the angel whose harp he breaks; his calm guide. Personality: calm, composed, quietly hurt
@harp = Harp (prop): the ONLY harp at Heaven's gate
@heaven_gate = Heaven's gate (location): pale stone landing on a cloud bank before an open golden gate
@end_frame = final frame. The shot must end exactly on this image - same framing, poses and positions.
@keyframe = start frame. Keep its framing and camera angle; the character design still comes from the character references.
Characters, environments and props 100% match the reference.

SHOT STRUCTURE
Single continuous shot, 9s.
Camera: Close-up, high angle, hold.
One unbroken take with no cuts: the camera moves smoothly and continuously so the final frame lands exactly on @end_frame (the next shot's opening frame).
- 0-3.9s: The harpist looks up, then down at him.
- 3.9-9s: He reaches for the harp; his fingers break into drifting motes of light.
Sound: rising shimmer, faint heartbeat

LOCKS & CONSTRAINTS
- No music. SFX and ambience only.
- No extra people, characters, text, logos or subtitles beyond the references.
- Characters, environments and props 100% match the reference images - same design, colors, proportions and outfit in every frame.
- Keep one consistent art style for the whole shot; no switch to photorealism.
- No spoken dialogue or narration audio - SFX and ambience only.
- No subtitles or on-screen text.
- Narrator is an adult man in his mid-twenties (adult face, defined jaw, adult height and proportions, not a teenager or child) in every frame - same age, face and body proportions as the reference; never younger or older.
- Harpist angel is a young adult woman in her mid-twenties in every frame - same age, face and body proportions as the reference; never younger or older.

ANIMATION PRINCIPLES
Apply the 12 principles of animation: squash and stretch, anticipation, staging, straight-ahead and pose-to-pose, follow-through and overlapping action, slow in and slow out, arcs, secondary action, timing, exaggeration, solid drawing, appeal. Movement is snappy and cartoony, with clear holds on key poses so every beat reads.
